throughline.zh: 本週首日資料涵蓋無人機晶片來源清查、AI ASIC 設計市場預測與台灣半導體設備進口統計，各自區分監管進度、預期及概估實績。
throughline.en: The first week-day coverage includes drone chip-origin reviews, AI ASIC market projections and semiconductor equipment import statistics, distinguishing enforcement, forecasts and advance data.

title.zh: 無人機晶片來源與政府採購查核
title.en: Drone chip provenance and public procurement

summary.zh: 內政部 10 月 31 日初步盤點 3 個機關涉及亞拓相關無人機採購共 32 架，包含移民署 30 架、總價 275 萬元但尚未交貨的合約。主管機關將核對非紅供應鏈規範，晶片來源與個案違約責任尚未有最終結論。
summary.en: On October 31 Taiwan's Interior Ministry identified 32 drone procurements across three agencies, including a NT$2.75 million, 30-unit immigration contract not yet delivered. Component provenance and contractual liability remain under investigation.

title.zh: 聯發科 AI ASIC 市占預期

summary.zh: 中央社 10 月 31 日補充報導聯發科 10 月 30 日法說：公司估 2027 年 AI 加速器 ASIC 市占約 20%，先前已公布首款 ASIC 自 9 月開始出貨。市占及營收屬公司未來預測。
summary.en: CNA's October 31 follow-up on MediaTek's October 30 investor briefing added a forecast of roughly 20% of AI accelerator ASIC market share in 2027. Initial September shipments have been reported, while the share and sales targets remain forecasts.

title.zh: 台灣經濟概估與半導體設備進口
title.en: Taiwan GDP estimate and semiconductor equipment imports

summary.zh: 主計總處 10 月 30 日公布第三季 GDP 年增概估 14.36%，中央社另引述半導體設備進口年增 35.66%。設備進口不等於完成裝機的產能。
summary.en: DGBAS released a 14.36% Q3 GDP advance estimate on October 30, while CNA reported semiconductor equipment imports increased 35.66% YoY. Imports do not establish commissioned fab capacity.
